newsitem.title: USA: USDA asks for comments on perishable license fees.
newsitem.headline: USDA asks for comments on perishable license fees.

text.p: USDA's Agricultural Marketing Service said Monday it would reopen the comment period until April 30 on proposed changes to license fees paid under the perishable commodities law.

The proposed changes to the license fee structure would phase retailers and grocery wholesalers out of license fee payments over a three-year period, and would establish a one-time administrative fee for new retailers and grocery wholesalers entering the program after the three-year phase out.
The changes would also increase license fees from $400 to $550 annually for all other licensees, according to the Agricultural Marketing Service.
The agency received a dozen responses from growers, shippers, retailers and grocery wholesalers on the proposed rule when an initial comment period was held last autumn.
